description: Gets a league's standings by league code: every club that plays in its current season, in table order, with its place, its regular-season record in the league's columns and, where the league ranks on points, its points. Answers "who leads the league" and "where are they in the standings".

code.description: The league's code, in any case.

name: get_league_standings

columns.description: The table's record columns, in reading order; every row's record holds each of them. A column a league shows only once there is one, the NFL's T, is here from the season's first such final.

onPoints.description: Whether the table ranks on points, so each row carries them.

rows.description: Every club the league lists with a regular-season game in the season, first place first.

points.description: The club's points, in a league that ranks on them; null elsewhere.

rank.description: The club's place, shared with every club level with it on everything the table ranks on.

record.description: The regular-season record in the table's columns, each of them, at zero too.

season.description: The season's slug (2026, 2025-2026); null for a league with no regular-season game, played or to come.

title: League standings
